scenes.title: Bedside Pill Bottle vs The Sponge-Pump Demonstration in Copenhagen Lab
scenes.era: 2025 University of Copenhagen & Oxford sleep-neurobiology discovery

layout.description: Split architectural vignette pairing a warm adult nightstand (amber pill vial, water glass, brass lamp) with a sunlit laboratory bench holding a clear borosilicate fluid-pump vessel and porous natural sponge.

positions.who: 55-year-old adult sleeper (stylized 2.5D vinyl character in burgundy cotton pajama cardigan seated on bed edge)
positions.where: holding an unmarked amber prescription vial in one hand and a clear water tumbler in the other before pausing thoughtfully
positions.facing: three-quarter view toward the bedside water glass

positions.who: Neurobiologist (stylized 2.5D vinyl character in crisp white lab coat over navy turtleneck)
positions.where: standing at a clean glass laboratory basin rhythmically squeezing and releasing a porous yellow cellulose sponge inside clear flowing water

props.name: Porous natural sponge submerged in a crystal-clear glass water basin
props.period_detail: tactile laboratory hydraulic analogy prop with zero text labels
props.physical_behavior: State A rhythmic gentle hand squeezes flush dark ink droplets cleanly out of the sponge into clear water -> State B clamped motionless hand leaves murky ink trapped inside the unpumped sponge

props.name: Unmarked amber glass pill vial and clear bedside water tumbler
props.period_detail: minimalist apothecary amber bottle with white cap on walnut nightstand
props.physical_behavior: adult sleeper sets the closed amber vial back onto the walnut tray and reaches instead to dim the warm brass bedside lamp

actions.verb_sequence: neurobiologist squeezes the submerged sponge in slow rhythmic pulses flushing dark droplets clear, then holds a second sponge clamped still where dark cloudiness lingers -> sleeper sets the closed amber vial down

reactions.reaction: nods with clear recognition that motionless sedation differs from active nightly rinsing

scenes.wardrobe: Sleeper in burgundy pajama cardigan; researcher in crisp white lab coat over navy turtleneck.
scenes.lighting: Warm evening bedside amber balanced against crisp high-key laboratory glass refraction.
scenes.recognition_hook: Being knocked unconscious is not the same as sleeping—certain sedatives mute the 50-second blood-vessel pump that washes your brain at night!

key_visual.description: an adult pausing beside an unmarked amber bedside vial while a neurobiologist rhythmically squeezes a submerged sponge in clear glass water to flush dark droplets clean

positions.where: volunteer resting comfortably on MRI cradle while clinician observes rhythmic fluid pulse timing

props.name: Cushioned MRI head coil and rhythmic fluid-wave cylinder model
props.physical_behavior: clear blue fluid surges smoothly up the demonstration tube every cycle

scenes.recognition_hook: Every natural slow wave triggers a fresh wave of clear fluid washing across your cortex.
